purpose: Teach: 役職/折衝/統括/取り寄せ/開演/切り上げ/一段落/振り回さ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 役職に頼らず、信頼で仕事しろ。
lines.en: Don't rely on your title. Build trust, and work from there.
lines.style: Quiet, measured opening. Each phrase given weight without hurry. Slight pause between statements—not rushing wisdom, but letting it land. Eyes steady, hands still.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。重要な折衝、若手にも経験させます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure our junior staff get hands-on experience with the important negotiations.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Leans forward slightly on 'Yes'—showing he's taken in the point. Clear, methodical delivery of the commitment. No defensiveness, just steady assurance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 統括役、若い頃から、責任を負った。
lines.en: A leader carries responsibility from the beginning. I learned that early.
lines.style: Nostalgic, slightly distant. Drawn into his own memory. Slower pace. The words come from lived experience, not instruction. Trailing slightly on the final phrase, as if remembering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。希少資料、取り寄せて、保管しています。
lines.en: Yes. I've made sure the rare materials are sourced carefully and stored properly.
lines.style: Precise, professional. Crisp delivery on the practical details—showing competence without elaboration. Straightforward eye contact. The tone of someone who follows through on unspoken expectations.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 記念式典、開演前、礼を尽くせ。
lines.en: For the anniversary ceremony, attend to the details before the doors open. Show respect in the preparation.
lines.style: Instructive but not condescending. Clear beats on the key actions. Calm, authoritative—the voice of someone giving guidance that matters. Slight emphasis on 'before'—timing is part of the respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。長会議、適切に切り上げる、心がけます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll be mindful about wrapping up long meetings on time—not letting them drag on.
lines.style: Assured, practical. Direct acknowledgment at the start. The commitment comes across as something he's already thinking about. Focused, efficient—matching the action he's describing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 一段落するごとに、振り返る時間、大事だ。
lines.en: Taking time to reflect after each milestone—that's essential. Don't skip that.
lines.style: Firm but gentle. Emphasis on 'essential' carries conviction without harshness. Slight lean forward, as if marking something important. Pace slows near the end. The final phrase has weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。日々の業務に振り回されない、長期視点で。
lines.en: Yes. I won't get caught up in the daily rush. I'll keep the long-term view in mind.
lines.style: Steady closing statement. Deliberate, almost meditative. No rush to finish. 'Long-term view' lands with quiet certainty—not bravado, but grounded resolution. Slight breath after 'Yes', showing he's absorbing the whole conversation.
